text_block_list.text: One day, as I was passing behind the school building…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you, Trainer. Don't surprise me like that.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. I had the same pain this morning, but it subsided quickly. In fact—

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Followers
text_block_list.text: There you are, King! We were looking for you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm sorry for disappearing all of a sudden. I got sidetracked.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'll heading to the plaza soon, so could you guys go on ahead?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Let's not tell them anything. I don't like people worrying about me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely let everyone know when I'm really not feeling well. There's no need to worry.
King Halo seems to be suffering from a headache…
